title: Quantitative Particle Approximation for Controlled Nonlinear Filtering
summary: We estimate convergence rates of value functions for particle approximations of a controlled nonlinear filtering problem. The state is a McKean--Vlasov diffusion on the flat torus, driven by hidden idiosyncratic noise and observed common noise. The filter---the conditional law of the state given the observations---serves as the state variable of the control problem, and the associated value function solves a second-order Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equation on the Wasserstein space.
